title: 1.5 Brothers, Sisters, and Adults
unit_outcome: Understand and produce simple sentences about people, family members, and actions.
goal: Name brothers and sisters, then use an with adult to meet the grown-ups in the family.
grammar_function: A + brother/sister; An + adult; They are + plural family word; The + group + are + action.
prerequisite: Lesson 1.4: family, baby, babies, child, and children.
speaking_outcome: Name a brother, brothers, a sister, sisters, an adult, and adults, and say what the adults are doing.

cards.pedagogy_note: Story beat 01: He is a brother.
Story beat 04: She is a sister.
Story beat 07: He is an adult.
Story beat 10: The adults are sitting.
